## FAQ
### What does a performance marketer do?
I plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google so that ad spend turns into leads and sales, not just likes and views.

### How much should I spend on Meta Ads in Dubai?
Most small businesses can start learning with AED 2,000–5,000 a month. Bigger budgets scale results once we know what converts. The budget calculator on this page gives a rough estimate.

### What's a good cost per lead for WhatsApp ads in the UAE?
In my recent business-setup campaigns in Dubai, WhatsApp conversations cost about AED 2.28–7.74 each. Your costs depend on your offer, audience and creative.

### Do you work with businesses outside the UAE?
Yes. I've run campaigns for brands in the UAE and India across e-commerce, education, real estate, automotive, media and fitness.

### Which platforms do you run ads on?
Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Search, Snapchat, plus SEO and organic social content.

### How do we start working together?
Message me on WhatsApp or use the form on this page. I'll reply within a day with a few questions, then we plan your first campaign.
